I'd really like an episode from the first day of the zombie outbreak. I haven't read the manga so I don't know if that happens, but it'd be nice. I also like the changes to the OP, but I hope not too many people who haven't seen episode 1 see it.

Gakkou Gurashi! is definitely my favourite show of the season. This is the second time I've ever been tense while watching an anime (first would be Shinsekai Yori), which is great. However, they seemed a bit too careless with their "Test of Courage". Letting Yuki run ahead, talking above a whisper, bringing the dog, and not closing and keeping a guard at the door in the school store. Also, they need to work on the staircase barricade, it seems too easy for a zombie to tip it over or even push it and create an opening.

I'm so in love with this show. The moe horror feel is a great treat. I'm glad they all take care of Yuki, and it was neat that the other girls acknowledge Megu for helping Yuki. I can't wait for next week!

After watching the first episode, i was afraid that this show would turn into just another zombie story, like the Walking Dead or such. I'm really happy that they kept with the schizofrenia aspect, and i'm hoping it'll continue. If they end up dropping that, without some major consequence to Yuki's character, i'm gonna be really disappointed. I also absolutely love that fact that they actually make the individual zombies feel dangerous or scary. In other zombie films I've seen, they've ended up fighting 10 20 or even a hundred zombies at a time, and that kinda diminishes the effect when they're on screen. After paying close attention throughout the episode, i'm convinced that Sakura is dead, and just a part of Yuki's imagination. The just appears and disappears now and then, and the only person who actually has a conversation with her is Yuki. The others only affirms her existence when they thank her for something, or says hi, and they never actually respond to her when she says something. So far Gakkou Gurashi is one of my top shows of the season, but also the one i'm most expecting to drop some time down the road.

Anyways, a little plot twist for you :)
